# fastmean

This is an R package that includes a function called `num_mean_categorical`.

The goal of fastmean is to allow a fast way to calculate the mean of one or more numeric variables for each level of a categorical variable using `num_mean_categorical`.

## Installation

Package installation can be done directly by calling:
`devtools::install_github("joshhellm/fastmean")`

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("UBC-STAT545-F2026/assignmentB2JoshuaHellmann")
```

## Example

This is a basic example which shows you how to use `num_mean_categorical` with the `penguins` dataset from the `palmerpenguins` package. It calculates the mean flipper and bill length for each island:

```{r example}
library(fastmean)
library(palmerpenguins)

num_mean_categorical(palmerpenguins::penguins, island, flipper_length_mm, bill_length_mm, removenas = TRUE)

```
